existingImages.title: The chai table
existingImages.provenance: AI generated in the design-review workflow; original prompt retained
existingImages.originalPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide website hero for an Indian snack brand design concept. Primary request: an inviting contemporary Indian afternoon chai table photographed from a slightly elevated editorial angle. A rectangular low dark wooden table, two clear cutting-chai glasses filled with milky tea on small steel saucers, a matte ceramic bowl of golden short seeded crunchy sticks, a second bowl of round millet crisps, small bowl of green chutney. Saffron and terracotta linen, subtle indigo block-print fabric at one corner, warm sun through a window. Natural tactile food texture, beautiful premium contemporary food magazine photography, relaxed lived-in modern Indian home, no people. Composition: landscape 3:2, food tableau on right two thirds, left third a softly shadowed warm dark-brown wall and tabletop with uncluttered negative space, balanced room for an HTML headline overlay on left. Rich cocoa shadows, toasted warm highlights, no green foliage-heavy styling. Constraints: no packaging, no labels, no logos, no writing, no watermark; illustrative food concept, no certification or health symbols.
existingImages.use: Home occasion, Story and seed-stick pairing galleries
existingImages.launchAction: Reuse for a shared tea occasion only if the visible sticks and crisps match the published range. Replace round crisps if the real SKU is ridged.
